caption:
Where is the greater palatine foramen? In a cadaver study on palatal graft harvesting, it was most often located between the second and third molars (66.6%). Examiners also tended to estimate the greater palatine neurovascular bundle closer to the cemento-enamel junction than it actually was, by up to 4 mm, and agreement was lower in high palatal vaults. Note: small sample of 11 cadavers.

Source: Fu JH, Hasso DG, Yeh CY, Leong DJ, Chan HL, Wang HL. The accuracy of identifying the greater palatine neurovascular bundle: a cadaver study. J Periodontol. 2011;82:1000-1006. PMID 21284546
